findings.issue: lockpick rendered as مفتاح (a key). Tiel is a thief who picks the lock in the very next beat (Only one lock? / Easy.); a key and a lockpick are different objects and the Arabic removes the whole point of the scene.
findings.suggested_ar: أداةُ فتح أقفالٍ واحدة، تمامًا كما وُعِدت.

findings.source_en: Now… where’d my “friend” leave the lockpick?
findings.issue: Same defect as the sibling row: lockpick rendered as المفتاح (the key). Both rows must use the same corrected term.
findings.suggested_ar: الآن... أين ترك «صديقي» أداة فتح الأقفال؟

findings.issue: تنصيب means installing/appointing someone to an office (تنصيب الملك). This is a cult initiation rite being performed on a restrained Tiel, not an appointment to a post.

findings.source_en: But you—you–can be strong, in ways that I’m not.
findings.ar: لكنك... أنت... قد تقوى حيث أعجز أنا.
findings.issue: can be strong is a statement of capability, but قد تقوى reads as may perhaps grow strong and injects doubt into what is the Undermether key thematic line about the Harbinger.
findings.suggested_ar: لكنك... أنت... تستطيع أن تقوى حيث أعجز أنا.
